layer_meaning.apple_states: Only what Apple's text explicitly states. stops/continues (and existing_data) carry evidence ids pointing to Apple's exact sentences. stated_as says how: 'direct_statement', or 'purpose_of_instruction' when Apple states the effect only as the purpose of a how-to sentence ('To stop X, turn off Y' / 'If you do not want X, turn off Y'). A how-to that names no effect is not a statement. 'default_behaviour_page': the sentence names no switch and applies to the off state only because Apple says that page 'outlines the default behavior for Siri and Dictation' (E147).
layer_meaning.reasonable_reader: What an ordinary reader would expect from the same text. A judgement; judged_by says whose.

how_to_rule.rule: A how-to sentence counts only if it states its own purpose; such claims are labelled purpose_of_instruction.
